prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Gozuryu, revered five-headed dragon protector of Kamakura.
ANATOMY: ONE enormous serpentine dragon body with EXACTLY FIVE separate long necks, each ending in ONE dragon head; total FIVE heads and TEN eyes [gozuryu-c06]. Fan arrangement: two heads left, one largest centre, two heads right, clear dark gaps between each neck. Each head has a dignified dragon face with small swept horns, not evil screaming. ONE continuous scaled body/tail; limbs underwater, none added or duplicated. No wings.
MOMENT: Rise forcefully from marsh water toward viewer, five necks arch in a protective wall, all five faces clearly visible, central head inclines to regard viewer. Physical water pours off scales; huge ripples push reeds outward. No victims, no sacrifice, no attack.
POWER: Formerly cruel dragon reformed into god protecting people from disaster [gozuryu-c04,gozuryu-c06]. Only physical emergence and waves, no invented disaster-control fire or lightning.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low water-level close view, FIVE large heads fan across square, marsh reeds tiny below body; fivehead silhouette readable at 200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon or lamp, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Former lake or nearby marsh of Kamakura with distant Enoshima coast [gozuryu-c01,gozuryu-c06].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred and benevolent figures remain dignified and protective.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Gozuryu, revered five-headed dragon protector of Kamakura
aura: Documented anatomy and action create presence without generic aura.
artistic_choices: Choose reformed protector rather than cruel history; no harm or sacrifice. Scales/horns/serpentine body editorial dragon morphology, no invented elemental powers.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: exactly FIVE separate dragon heads/necks in clear 2-left/1-centre/2-right fan, single continuous scaled body, limbs underwater. Five faces dignified protective gaze, no attack, fire or invented disaster effects. Rising water physically spills from scales, low marsh perspective, no text or aura. All seven Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + a tight head-fan crop. Exactly FIVE dragon heads (五頭竜, gozuryu-c01) counted on five distinct necks — two on the left, one dominant horned central head, two on the right — all rising from a single scaled body (not five separate dragons), each head with two eyes, mane, horns and whiskers. The body emerges from a moonlit lake/marsh with water physically sheeting off the scales; reeds in the foreground, distant lit island (gozuryu-c01/c06). Sober, majestic protective bearing of the reformed deity (gozuryu-c04/c06) — no attack on people, no victims. Original scale and mane forms, no invented elemental beams, no generic aura or text; monumental and awe-inspiring at 200px.
